{{Quote|In a hundred years, they won't remember me for the Treaty at Bresnan or how I saved Starbright Station.|Ki Sazen|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Chronicles|Taris}}</ref>}}
The '''Starbright Station''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] saved the station from an impending threat, an action she considered among her personal accomplishments.<ref name="TOR" />
